findings.text: the fragment asserts the three hours sit in conductor insertion that precedes the plasma-grid bar and that the case never reaches its first plasma-grid batch, but the cited stored-cases-titan.log cannot order the bar in wall time (tqdm elapsed is relative; only CASE_INPUT at 15:18:36 and the cancel at 19:18:47 are absolute), it shows the bar running to 59/60 and being killed seconds short, and both the node goal and the brief place the time after the plasma grid; the attribution is an unverified inference, not an observation.
the stack line names tests/test_equilibrium_forward_reference.py:1207 cached_machine, but head-sample.log and the source put that frame at :1208.
the 242 calls that exceed half a second and the exponent 2.06 do not reproduce from arms2.log arm h, which has 326 such calls and a fitted exponent of 2.049.
the last sort alone is about 50 s contradicts the fragment's own fitted law, which gives about 33 s at 30 000 rows (4.806 s x (30000/11756)^2.06).
the base arm is credited with 1906 sort_link calls; arms2.log shows both arms ran 1907 (final SORTLINK_END call=1906) and the fragment's own next paragraph also says 1 907 and 1 906.

the cost-law table has no figure although the declared write paths include docs/figures/inverse-equilibrium-baseline/stored-case-build-stall-diagnosis, and a log-log plot would show the quadratic exponent directly.
